procedure_text: To a clean and pre-dried 250mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (160mL) NMSBA (27g, 0.11mol) and 1,3-cyclohexanedione(12g, 0.11mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. To this mixture, N,N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (24g, 0.12mol) was added and stirred for about2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was quenched with water (160mL) and separated the organic layer. The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as white crystalline solid. HPLC purity >85%; Yield: 25.4g (68%); Melting point: 158-163°C and Solvent recovery: >85%.
procedure_summary: The carboxylic acid NMSBA and 1,3-cyclohexanedione are stirred together in dichloromethane at ambient temperature and the carbodiimide coupling agent is then added, esterifying the acid onto the enol oxygen of the dione without any acid chloride. The mixture is quenched with water and the separated organic layer is concentrated to give the enol ester as a white crystalline solid.
